_readme: Copy this file to appsettings.Local.json (git-ignored) and fill in the projects. RootPath and Library are optional; without them the library reads the .orchestra/ layout under RootPath, which is derived only from an orchestrator/runs or .orchestra/runs RunsPath. ProfilesPath is optional: a relative value sits beside the database (plan 0006 D5). ReportToken is optional: unset means the dashboard makes and keeps one in the database's folder (plan 0009 D6). EnginePath is optional: the engine folder to use when it is not the one found above the content root (plan 0012 D12). BrowseRoots limits the folder browser (plan 0009 D5).
